messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 Alert: p95 latency spike on serving-runtime (eu-west-1) observed across text-generation routes. Started at 2043216760. Tags: perf, realtime
sasha: seeing it in dashboards — p95 ~750ms, p50 ~120ms. Throughput dropped ~18% on same hosts. Not universal; some shards fine.
kevin: I ran a quick profile on one affected shard. Kernel autoswitch picked the SSE-optimized kernel for short sequences but perf counters show high L3 misses and much higher branch mispredicts. Suspect misselection for mixed-length workload. snippet:```perf top -p 1234 
Samples: 1K of event 'cycles'
  30.2%  serving_runtime:kernel_sse_impl
  26.8%  serving_runtime:kernel_vec_impl
  12.1%  libc-2.31.so
```
maria: KV cache metrics show a spike in evictions for tenant=T-44 right when p95 started. evictions/sec jumped x6, local hit-rate dropped from 92% -> 64%.
jonah: T-44 is a heavy bursty tenant (batching patterns vary). If KV churn + wrong kernel was chosen, it could amplify tail latency. Might be noisy neighbor.
priya: can we gate kernel_autoswitch to prefer vec_impl until KV warm? there's a kernel selection backoff flag we added last quarter.
sasha: i can instrument selection decisions but need a quick mitigation now. Options: 1) enable per-tenant throttle for T-44, 2) flip batching heuristic FF to legacy heuristics, 3) set kernel_autoswitch backoff to conservative, 4) route T-44 to dedicated nodes.
kevin: quick check — kernel_autoswitch has a config `autoswitch_backoff_ms` default 100ms. bumping to 1000ms will force stable kernel choice for short-lived requests.
priya: i can flip the feature flag for batching heuristics. ops-bot can we do a controlled toggle on 10% of serving pool?
ops-bot: Runbook step: toggle flag via feature service. Example:```curl -X POST https://ffsvc.internal/api/toggle 
 -d '{"flag":"legacy_batching","percent":10,"env":"eu-west-1"}' 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN'```
ops-bot: Or patch runtime config for kernel backoff:```kubectl -n serving set env deployment/runtime-main KERNEL_AUTOSWITCH_BACKOFF_MS=1000 --record```
sasha: let's do both: flip legacy_batching to 20% first and bump KERNEL_AUTOSWITCH_BACKOFF_MS cluster-wide for eu-west-1 nodes. I'll watch.
kevin: i'll prepare a small canary patch to lower max_batch_size for T-44: `max_batch_size=8` (was 64). That reduces queuing pressure while KV warms.
maria: started a targeted KV eviction policy to stabilize cache hot sets for T-44 (warmup hold). Command:```POST /internal/kv/evict?tenant=T-44&mode=preserve_hot```
ops-bot: toggling legacy_batching -> 20% in eu-west-1 (canary) now.
ops-bot: patched env KERNEL_AUTOSWITCH_BACKOFF_MS=1000 on deployment/runtime-main-eu-west-1-canary (4 pods). Rolling restart initiated.
sasha: canary metrics look promising — p95 on canary dropped from 740ms -> 220ms within two minutes.
jonah: OK push to 100% for region? Risk: might affect throughput for some other tenants but p95 improvement is substantial.
priya: i'm moving legacy_batching -> 100% for eu-west-1. ops-bot please coordinate rollout.
ops-bot: legacy_batching set to 100% eu-west-1, canary pods promoted, full env patch applied to runtime-main. Rolling restarts finishing.
kevin: lowering T-44 max_batch_size to 8 applied. Monitor: queue depth fell, p50 stable, p95 trending down.
maria: KV eviction policy shows hit-rate recovering to 88% after 5 minutes. Evictions/sec back to normal.
sasha: overall p95 region-wide is down to ~210ms, throughput recovered to +15% vs peak-drop. Good signal.
jonah: follow-up actions: - add selection telemetry for kernel decisions by sequence-length distribution, - add per-tenant KV warmup policy to avoid noisy churn, - add automated rollback if p95>500ms during rollouts.
priya: filing a post-incident ticket with root-cause analysis and actions. I'll include kernel selection regression hypothesis and batching heuristic change notes.
kevin: re: root cause — looks like combination of sudden tenant with high variance in seq lengths + kernel_autoswitch being too sensitive to transient stats -> chose bad kernel -> high stalls under L3 pressure + KV churn amplified tails.
sasha: thanks all. I'll leave the rollback guards and telemetry until we confirm stable for 2 hours. tagging incident resolved once stable.
incident-bot: Incident update: p95 in eu-west-1 returned to baseline. Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Start time 2043216760, mitigation applied 2043216845, last check 2043217345. :white_check_mark:
